Present: Senator Ann H. Rest - Chair, Senator Matt D. Klein - Vice Chair, Senator Bill

Senator Ann H. Rest called the meeting to order at 8:35 a.m.

S.F. 5194: Senator Klein: Refundable credit proposal for conversion of underutilized
buildings.

Testifiers:

Dan Collison, Senior Director of Business Development and Public Affairs, Sherman Associates
Heidi Swank, Executive Director, Rethos

Adam Duininck, President and CEO, Minneapolis Downtown Council

Jacob Frey, Mayor, City of Minneapolis

Nicolle Goodman, Director of Planning and Economic Development, City of St. Paul

Joe Spencer, President, St. Paul Downtown Alliance

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5194 be laid over.

S.F. 4862: Senator Oumou Verbeten: Certain uncodified provision in federal law that
relates to provisions of the Internal Revenue Code does not apply provision.

Testifiers:

Joanna Bayers — Legislative Director, Department of Revenue

John Reynolds — State Director, National Federation of Independent Business
John Hausladen — President, Minnesota Trucking Association

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 4862 be laid over.

S.F. 5168: Senator Klein: Individual income, corporate franchise, and sales and use taxes
assessments limitations provisions.

Testifier:
Geno Fragnito, Director of Government Relations, MNCPA

Senator Rest moved that S.F. 5168 be laid over.
The gavel was transferred to Senator Klein.

S.F. 4486: Senator Hauschild: Property tax exemption for certain property owned by an
Indian Tribe.

Senator Rest presented the bill for Senator Hauschild.

Testifiers:

Robert Deschampe — Chairman, Grand Portage Band of Lake Superior Chippewa

April McCormick — Secretary/Treasurer, Grand Portage Band of Lake Superior Chippewa
Senator Klein moved that S.F. 4486 be laid over.

S.F. 4983: Senator Hauschild: Data centers sales and use tax exemption modification.

Senator Rest presented the bill for Senator Hauschild.
